name: David J. Gallagher
tagline: Top rated Medical Malpractice attorney in Chicago, Illinois
side_practice_areas: Medical Malpractice, Personal Injury, General Litigation
education: Northern Illinois University College of Law
about: A judicious legal advocate for his clients, David J. Gallagher strives to provide them with the top-quality representation they deserve in contentious personal injury matters pertaining to motor vehicle accidents and medical malpractice, among many others. At the law office of Napleton & Partners in Chicago, Illinois, he serves residents throughout the surrounding region and beyond.

Mr. Gallagher completed his undergraduate studies in 2004, graduating with his Bachelor of Science degree in political science from the University of Illinois Chicago. He went on to attend the Northern Illinois University College of Law, where he strengthened his legal acumen through his involvement in student organizations, such as the Student Bar Association – where he served as treasurer and vice president – as well as competitions, including the 24th Annual NIU College of Law Moot Court Competition, where he was a semifinalist. He received his Juris Doctor in 2007, and in the same year, he obtained his license to practice law in Illinois.

A consummate professional through and through, Mr. Gallagher is a stalwart champion for his clients, pursuing every available legal avenue to get them the compensation they deserve for the injuries they have sustained. Some of his notable verdicts and settlements include many medical malpractice cases, including a settlement of $7 million, a verdict of $3.8 million in a case involving a spinal procedure, a settlement of $6.75 million and a verdict of $1.7 million, among many others. For his many contributions, he has been included in the Chicago Law Daily Bulletin’s 40 Under 40 up-and-coming lawyers list.
honors: Recognized by the Chicago Daily Law Bulletin as one of the attorneys selected to the list of 40 under 40 in an annual survey of up-and-coming lawyers.
Recognized as an Emerging Lawyer by the Law Bulletin Publishing Company from 2015 to 2022.
Recognized as a Super Lawyers Rising Star from 2019 to 2022.
